canonical_project: CTC Data Center Nagoya Marunouchi (CTCデータセンター名古屋丸の内)
notes: Urban hyperscale-grade data center in Nagoya city center (Marunouchi), seismic-isolated structure with up to 1.5 t/sqm floor load; CTC operates three DC locations in Nagoya, including Nagoya Station South (opened Oct 2000); capacity not publicly stated.
